highlights: Same 24 tasks, memory generation included: 32.57% fewer tokens and 15.42% lower estimated model cost, with both groups solving the same 16 tasks.
2026-11-16 · v1.5.2 — Batched writes and query optimizations: maintainer measurements report about 190% higher write throughput and 171% higher query throughput than v1.5.1.
2026-11-09 · v1.5.1 — Trace memories to precise source locations, plus an optional monitoring stack for metrics, logs, and traces.
2026-11-23 · v1.6.0 — Knowledge bases debut: import Markdown and images, search with hybrid retrieval, and manage revisioned chunks in the Dashboard.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 让 Agent 少走弯路、少花 Token。
highlights_zh: 同 24 题，计入记忆生成： Token 减少 32.57%，估算模型成本降低 15.42%，两组解出相同的 16 题。
2026-11-16 · v1.5.2 — 批量写入和查询优化：维护者实测写入吞吐提升约 190%、查询吞吐提升约 171%（对比 v1.5.1）；Dashboard 原生展示处理进度、失败诊断和 Token 用量。
2026-11-03 · v1.5.0 — Source 与 Artifact 插件，可扩展数据接入和自定义制品；用可逆编码减少模型输入中的重复证据。
2026-11-09 · v1.5.1 — 记忆可追溯到来源中的精确位置；新增可选的监控栈，覆盖指标、日志和链路追踪。
